title: 第一卷 南域篇 第11章 苦海三重一剑断木第一卷 南域篇 第12章 大道十九一线生
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
那场暴雨，来的快，去的也快。北境夏天，大雨皆是如此。
白泽负剑上山，没有刻意去找元方。他修的是御剑，第一步是举重若轻。若白泽所料不错，他的修剑之路，先砍柴，再学一剑刺柳，不动真气而能无锋剑至，齐穿九叶。
白泽不同，虽也砍柴，却是以无锋剑气，一剑断木。
道不同，不相为谋。
“可无锋之剑，也有可断十年木之剑气吗？”后山密林，白泽听群鸟脆鸣，思量良久，然后挑了一棵三人合抱的悬铃木，砍将起来。
“不管了，要想断木，需先知此剑剑气为何。空想无益，且先试剑！”白泽手上运力，一剑斩出，却震得自己虎口发麻，柳剑差点脱手而出。
反观悬铃木，却只破了点皮。
“果然没这么简单。”白泽叹了口气，却不气馁，仍旧兀自砍柴，只闻“咄咄”之声不绝于耳，群鸟也因此震飞而起，喳喳乱叫。
一连数日，白泽都是上山砍柴一个时辰。因为他和元方上山时间不同，所以没有相遇。
直到第五天，白泽正挥剑砍柴，忽然听到背后有脚步声传来，回头一看，正是元方。
四目相对，元方奇道：“你也砍柴？”
“嗯。”白泽看见陈元方，想着时间也差不多了，于是收剑而立，甩了甩麻木的右手，问：“你砍得怎么样了？”
“唔，昨天刚断一木。”陈元方说，看着白泽所砍树木剑痕已有四指深，赞道：“白泽，你选的这棵悬铃木，在整座后山，其木质也算得上数一数二的坚硬了。我看你应该没砍几天吧？剑痕还是新的，就已经砍这么深了，真是厉害！”
“我也没办法，我天生神力，寻常树木对我来说并算不得困难。”白泽耸肩，席地而坐，随手摘了身边的覆盆子吃了起来，道：“只是这无锋之剑，砍起柴来，当真不易。”
元方见状，也坐了下来，顺手摘着酸甜的覆盆子吃了起来，叹了口气，说：“我也想过这个问题，可你还记得那日我们在松岗边，目睹你师父一剑平山岗吗？”
“记得，怎么了？”白泽问。
“当时你师傅说，”陈元方摸着手中的无锋柳剑，道：“下剑杀人，中剑聚气，上剑凝意，至剑唯心。我就在想，我手中的剑虽然确实无锋，可我要是想抵达剑道巅峰，那么我心中的剑，难道也要像手中剑一样，无刃无锋吗？”
一语惊醒梦中人。
白泽怔然良久，大笑起来，一把抱住陈元方的双肩，摇将道：“哈哈！谁说你天资愚钝的？我看你分明是大智若愚！说得好！元方，手中剑可无锋，可心中剑，当锐不可挡！”
说罢，他拔剑一斩，奋力劈向身旁的悬铃木。

只听“铎”的一声，柳剑登时深入硬木三分之一，切口平整，丝毫不像之前那样毛毛糙糙！
“啊！？”陈元方被白泽突然一剑吓了一跳，慌忙站了起来，看着白泽一剑之威，瞠目结舌。
柳剑脱手，死死卡在悬铃木中。
白泽只觉虎口钻心疼痛，一看，原来手掌皮肤开裂，巨大的反震之力让他的右手此刻鲜血淋漓！
“你受伤了？”陈元方撕下一截衣服，为白泽包扎伤口，埋怨道：“即使有所感悟，也不能如此莽撞啊！你看你，把手伤的这般严重，看来三天之内，你都不能上山砍柴了……”
一边说，一边细心将白泽伤口包扎妥当。
“无妨，无法一剑断木，只因我气力不足。待我破苦海三重天，我再来这里取剑，然后完成师尊交代的任务，一剑斩断十年木！”白泽满不在乎，可一低头，看见元方兄长般对他仔细的照顾，忽然心里如被什么东西扎了一下。
“好兄弟！”白泽看着陈元方，拍了拍他的肩膀，道：“有朝一日，我们一定看遍九州天下，让天下所有的人，都记住我们的名字！”
“好！”陈元方重重点头，也拍着白泽的肩膀，眼神坚定：“你若要成剑仙，我就当剑圣！我们一起，看遍九州天下！”
北境小小的河阳城境，柳庄后山，树林之间，两个年少的少年，就这么，立下了一生之盟！
天道险阻，可不知者无畏。少年之约，真正能实现的，又有几个呢？
“这覆盆子着实酸甜可口！”陈元方咧嘴一笑，爽朗气息扑面而来，蹲下身，摘了许多，兜在衣服上，说：“摘些回去，带给师傅他们和彩云妹妹尝尝。”
“你不说，我倒是忘了！这些日子，吃了许多小姐姐亲手送来的葱花饼，没有表示，心里难免过意不去。”白泽想起小姑娘可爱的笑脸，哈哈一笑，说：“你摘些覆盆子，那我要去山下抓鱼！今天中午，我们何不相约一起，在山下水潭边，来一次野餐？”
“有趣！有趣！”陈元方也笑了起来，说：“可惜土根和二蛋家里管的严，否则可以叫来一起。这样，你我分头行动，你烤鱼，我回家叫彩云妹妹，顺便从家里带些盐巴！”
“快去快回！”白泽说，不再多言，奔下山去，抓鱼生火。
content_en:
That heavy rain came and went quickly. This is the case with heavy rains in summer in the north.
Bai Ze carried his sword and went up the mountain without deliberately looking for Yuan Fang. He is practicing sword control, and the first step is to lift the weight as lightly as possible. If Bai Ze's prediction is correct, his way of practicing swordsmanship is to chop wood first, and then learn to stab a willow with a sword. Without moving his true energy, he can reach without a sharp sword and pierce the nine leaves.
Bai Ze is different. Although he also chops firewood, he uses his sharp sword energy to break wood with one sword.
The ways are different and they do not conspire against each other.
"Can a sword without a sharp edge still have the energy of a sword that can cut through a ten-year-old tree?" In the dense forest at the back of the mountain, Bai Ze listened to the chirping of the birds, thought for a long time, then picked a sycamore tree that three people hugged each other, and chopped it down.
"No matter, if you want to break the wood, you need to know the sword energy of this sword. It's useless to dream about it, let's try the sword first!" Bai Ze used his strength in his hand and slashed out with the sword, but the shock made his mouth numb, and Liu Jian almost came out.
On the other hand, the sycamore tree only had some skin damage.
"Sure enough, it's not that simple." Bai Ze sighed, but was not discouraged. He continued to chop wood by himself. He could only hear the sound of "duh duh", which caused the birds to fly up and chirp.
For several days, Bai Ze went up the mountain to chop wood for an hour. Because he and Yuan Fang went up the mountain at different times, they did not meet.
Until the fifth day, Bai Ze was chopping firewood with his sword when he suddenly heard footsteps coming from behind. When he turned around, he saw that it was Yuan Fang.
Their eyes met, Yuan Fang asked curiously: "You also chop wood?"
"Yes." Bai Ze saw Chen Yuanfang and thought that time was almost up, so he put away his sword and stood up, shook his numb right hand and asked, "How is your cutting going?"
"Well, I just broke a tree yesterday." Chen Yuanfang said. Seeing that the sword marks on the trees Bai Ze cut were four fingers deep, he praised: "Bai Ze, the sycamore tree you chose has one of the hardest wood in the entire back mountain. I think you haven't cut it for a few days, right? The sword marks are still new, and the sword marks are already so deep. It's really impressive!"
"I can't help it. I'm born with supernatural power, and ordinary trees are not difficult for me." Bai Ze shrugged, sat on the ground, picked raspberries beside him and ate them, saying: "It's just that it's not easy to chop firewood with this bladeless sword."
Seeing this, Yuan Fang also sat down, picked some sweet and sour raspberries and ate them. He sighed and said, "I've thought about this too, but do you still remember that day when we were at the pine hillock and witnessed your master leveling the hillock with a sword?"
"Remember, what happened?" Bai Ze asked.
"Your master said at that time," Chen Yuanfang touched the edgeless willow sword in his hand, and said: "The lower sword kills, the middle sword gathers energy, the upper sword condenses the mind, and the upper sword focuses on the heart. I was thinking that although the sword in my hand is indeed edgeless, if I want to reach the peak of swordsmanship, then does the sword in my heart have to be edgeless like the sword in my hand?"
One word awakens the dreamer.
Bai Ze was stunned for a long time, then laughed, hugged Chen Yuanfang's shoulders, shook his head and said: "Haha! Who said you are stupid in nature? I think you are obviously as wise as a fool! Well said! Yuan Fang, the sword in your hand may have no edge, but the sword in your heart must be sharp and unstoppable!"
After that, he drew his sword and slashed hard at the sycamore tree next to him.
Just hearing the sound of "Duo", the willow sword immediately penetrated one-third of the hardwood, and the cut was smooth, not as rough as before!
"Ah!?" Chen Yuanfang was startled by Bai Ze's sudden sword strike. He stood up in a hurry and was dumbfounded when he saw the power of Bai Ze's sword strike.
Liu Jian lost his hand and got stuck in the sycamore tree.
Bai Ze felt a sharp pain in the tiger's mouth. When he saw it, it turned out that the skin on his palm was cracked, and the huge force of the shock caused his right hand to drip with blood!
"Are you injured?" Chen Yuanfang tore off a piece of clothes, bandaged Bai Ze's wound, and complained: "Even if you have some understanding, you can't be so reckless! Look at you, your hand is so seriously injured, it seems that you won't be able to go up the mountain to chop wood for three days..."
While talking, he carefully bandaged Bai Ze's wound.
"It doesn't matter, you can't cut the wood with one sword, just because I don’t have enough strength. When I break through the third level of the sea of ​​suffering, I will come here again to get the sword, and then complete the task assigned by the master, and cut off the ten-year-old tree with one sword! "Bai Ze didn't care, but when he lowered his head and saw Yuan Fang caring for him carefully like a brother, he suddenly felt as if something had stabbed him in his heart.
"Good brother! Bai Ze looked at Chen Yuanfang, patted his shoulder, and said: "One day, we will definitely visit the world of Jiuzhou and let everyone in the world remember our names!" "
"good! "Chen Yuanfang nodded heavily and patted Bai Ze's shoulder with firm eyes: "If you want to become a swordsman, I will become a swordsman! Let’s see all over the world together! "
In the small city of Heyang in the north, in the mountains behind Liuzhuang, among the woods, two young men formed a lifelong alliance just like that!
The way of heaven is dangerous, but those who don’t know are fearless. How many young people's promises can really come true?
“These raspberries are really sweet and sour! "Chen Yuanfang grinned, with a refreshing breath coming to his face. He squatted down, picked a lot, pocketed it on his clothes, and said, "Pick some back and bring them to Master, the others, and Sister Caiyun to taste. "
"If you didn't tell me, I would have forgotten! These days, I have eaten a lot of scallion pancakes delivered by the young lady, without expressing any regrets. Bai Ze thought of the little girl's cute smile, laughed, and said, "You pick some raspberries, then I'll go down the mountain to catch fish!" Today at noon, why don't we meet up and have a picnic by the pool at the foot of the mountain? "
"interesting! interesting! Chen Yuanfang also laughed and said, "It's a pity that Tu Gen and Er Dan's family are very strict, otherwise we could have called them together." In this way, you and I split up, you grill the fish, I go home and call Sister Caiyun, and bring some salt from home! "
"Go back quickly! Bai Ze said, without further words, he ran down the mountain to catch fish and make a fire.
